packageRules.description: Inactive Vitest canary preparation: replace the false match only after the reviewed issue 37 E enforcement, isolation and native-runtime gates pass.
#255: update the russh SSH stack of packages/ssh-native together; russh-sftp tracks russh releases.

#255 (until the first release that contains @paratix/ssh-native, expected with C2 #257): require Dependency Dashboard approval for every Cargo and npm update under packages/ssh-native, keep such updates out of automerge and give their commits the hidden type build(deps) instead of fix(deps). Vulnerability-alert PRs bypass dependencyDashboardApproval (Renovate forces its vulnerabilityAlerts defaults over packageRules, and those set dependencyDashboardApproval to false but neither semanticCommitType nor automerge), so the hidden commit type and automerge=false are what keep a security update under packages/ssh-native from becoming a releasable commit or merging without review before configure-trust.sh has run. Remove this rule after that release so security updates trigger releases again as fix(deps).
